node.title: Re^2: Accessing 2 multidimensional arrays simultaneously
node.author: Ppeoc
node.doctext: Thanks on your suggestion for dropping the join line to make it truly multidimensional. I am sorry that my question wasn't clear before. I want to display row 1 of the 1st array and then row 1 of the 2nd array. Like this: 'a','b','c','j','k','l'
